materials_exhausted.note: Bounded source recovery reopened local XML/PDF/OA package, pdftotext output, archive/supplement indexes, and linked database JSONL rows. No supplementary assets exist in the local package. Unsupported database sequence/name/variant claims are preserved as conflicts rather than fabricated or normalized.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked database citation/activity rows were rechecked against primary PDF/XML and database JSONL. The primary paper supports a bactericidal soil-bacillus extract and Gram-positive activity but not the Gramicidin A sequence/name, later structural annotations, antiviral labels, synthetic variants, or MIC values; final status preserves source_conflict/database_only_no_primary_source instead of source_verified identity.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired the missing activity layer by extracting recoverable Table I and growth-inhibition values from the PDF with raw units and locators. The rows are extract-dose/viability/lysis/growth outcomes, not MIC rows. No mammalian toxicity or hemolysis value for the extract is present locally.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 rebuilt mechanism claims from the paper: viability loss, secondary lysis, and associated inhibition of glucose dehydrogenase are source-located; causal mechanism and later channel/structural claims are not promoted.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Linked DRAMP/CAMP/dbAMP records refer to Gramicidin A or later variants, but the local 1939 XML/PDF/package supports only a soluble bactericidal agent from a soil bacillus plus activity/properties, not sequence, terminal modifications, or later structural identity.

Recoverable source values are extract amounts per 10^9 cells or per broth tube and qualitative viability/lysis/growth outcomes. No MIC, MBC, hemolysis, or mammalian cytotoxicity rows are present in the local paper material.
The OA package contains only the article PDF and NXML; supplementary index and supplementary table/text files are empty.
The paper supports viability loss, secondary lysis, and associated glucose-dehydrogenase inhibition, but does not prove the biochemical cause of death.

summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review repaired the missing activity layer from primary PDF evidence, source-reviewed linked database rows, and rebuilt final adjudication. The paper is accepted_with_cautions: extract activity values and mechanism cautions are source-supported, while database Gramicidin A sequence/name/variant annotations remain preserved as source_conflict or database_only_no_primary_source rather than normalized to unsupported primary-source facts.
